authority: Canonical lifecycle/index; immutable hypotheses and parameters live in hash-pinned preregistration artifacts; observations/results remain in their declared stores.

items.hypothesis: One fixed crypto spot family retains positive out-of-sample expectancy after conservative costs.
items.evidence_gate: positive at 20 bps per side on both products

items.hypothesis: The breakout family has positive prospective net expectancy only during objectively active weekdays.
items.reconciliation: next actionable candle open with frozen 20 bps per-side cost
items.evidence_gate: 100 eligible prospective observations or 14 calendar days; both products positive with bounded drawdown
items.failure_gate: either product non-positive, timestamp integrity failure, lookahead, or restart failure

items.hypothesis: A prospectively captured VALID BTC-USD public candle can drive one deterministic non-HOLD shadow intent through the canonical execution and accounting contracts with restart-safe receipts while actual financial exposure remains zero.
items.reconciliation: declared shadow fill events only; external venue truth is not available
items.evidence_gate: all frozen lifecycle, deterministic replay, restart, accounting, receipt-integrity, monitor-visibility, and zero-exposure gates pass
items.failure_gate: any prospective timestamp failure, invalid market evidence, authorization bypass, non-determinism, duplicate economic event, accounting divergence, credential/signer/venue action, or nonzero actual exposure

items.hypothesis: One prospective public BTC-USD L2 book/trade/product snapshot can calibrate or reject observable spread, depth, precision, minimum-notional, and capacity assumptions while correctly leaving fee tier, order latency, rejection, partial-fill, and actual-fill truth unqualified.
items.reconciliation: compare OBSERVED public book/product facts with CONFIGURED shadow assumptions; no external order/fill/account truth
items.evidence_gate: prospective VALID immutable bundle plus deterministic spread/depth/rule calculations and explicit unavailable classifications
items.failure_gate: non-prospective, stale, crossed/empty, disabled product, missing sequence/provenance, oversized payload, integrity/rebuild failure, credential/order/signer/wallet/capital access, or misclassification of unavailable execution truth

items.hypothesis: A bounded unauthenticated BTC-USD WebSocket journal can preserve continuous level2, trade, and heartbeat evidence with explicit per-channel sequence, duplicate, restart, integrity, and replay semantics and yield reproducible spread/depth distributions.
items.reconciliation: deterministic replay of the append-only raw public stream must reproduce final book and summary hashes
items.evidence_gate: all required channels, explicit gap/duplicate results, deterministic replay, crash recovery, corruption rejection, bounded storage, distributions, and zero-effect safety pass
items.failure_gate: missing channel/snapshot/update, ambiguous sequence/duplicate state, restart loss, replay divergence, corruption acceptance, resource-bound violation, authentication/account/order/signer/wallet/capital access, or misclassification of unavailable execution truth

items.hypothesis: A tested raw l2_data to logical level2 normalization can preserve provider provenance and allow the bounded public journal to pass required-channel, sequence, replay, restart, integrity, distributional, and zero-effect gates.
items.reconciliation: raw provider channel/payload provenance plus deterministic logical-channel replay must reproduce final book and summary hashes
items.evidence_gate: required logical channels with raw l2_data provenance, explicit gap/duplicate results, deterministic replay, crash recovery, corruption rejection, bounded storage, distributions, and zero-effect safety
items.failure_gate: first-attempt mutation, lost alias provenance, missing channel, ambiguous sequence/duplicate state, replay divergence, corruption/restart/bound failure, authentication/account/order/signer/wallet/capital access, or unavailable-truth misclassification
